cases.case_label: Ancestral SVA in FKTN causing exon trapping (FCMD)
cases.mechanism_detail: From review: the ancestral SVA insertion in fukutin induces aberrant mRNA splicing by SVA exon-trapping; antisense oligonucleotides targeting the splice sites restored normal splicing and fukutin function in patient cells and model mice.
cases.quote: We show that aberrant mRNA splicing induced by SVA exon-trapping caused FCMD.
